query:
SELECT picked.id AS "id!"
        FROM (
            SELECT el.id, el.macro_id
            FROM email_links el
            WHERE el.id = ANY($2::uuid[])
            OFFSET 0
        ) picked
        WHERE picked.macro_id = $1
        UNION
        SELECT asked.id
        FROM unnest($2::uuid[]) AS asked(id)
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT 1
            FROM macro_user_links mul
            WHERE mul.link_id = asked.id AND mul.primary_macro_id = $1
            LIMIT 1
        ) delegated
